status: Second fixed allocation experiment after the no-participation variant failed; reused seasons, not an untouched test

allocation.selection: Existing lowest game-ID hash sample; no selection on outcomes

limits: Raw role MAE is not the final allocation acceptance metric
Current-game starter, injury and actual participation information cannot enter feature generation
A failed gate does not change live model defaults

participation.method: Beta(1,1) smoothed frequency of observed positive-minute appearances in the last ten earlier complete team reports
participation.missingness: An absent player is an unobserved appearance exposure, never a confirmed DNP label; target-game missing records are excluded and reported
participation.recentTeamChangeFallback: Use earlier global listed-game frequency when the two latest observed teams differ
